    Evidence harness: measure, control, record¶

    Living document, last changed 2026-11-06 at e95108d74.

    The programme's evidence has one shape. A harness require()s the shipping module by path from a worktree so the thing measured is the thing that ships; it runs against a throwaway database with synthetic data; it asserts liveness before and after each measured step; and each claimed property has a meaningful known-bad control before its green is believed. One independent control may exercise several assertions when it exposes the same failure mechanism.

    Choose the verification boundary¶

    Finish a complete capability or adopted milestone criterion within its lane. Use focused/affected checks during implementation. For cgm-remote-monitor, the integration coordinator owns full/browser/enabled-corpus acceptance on the coherent frozen candidate; resumption, a helper commit or another control does not trigger that campaign. Retain exact-head attribution and required semantic/clinical safeguards.

    An early native proof is useful when its result could change the architecture or establish a critical boundary. State its question and exit condition, then join its result into the capability. After an unexpected failure, preserve the symptom and diagnose narrowly. Setup-only failures need preflight repair before another campaign, with the invalid capture retained. Record one capability/batch evidence bundle and link it from the evolving handoff; individual control logs stay in that bundle rather than each becoming a new programme acceptance record.

    Pick the instrument¶

    question instrument where
    does a write path store, stamp, delete and announce a record the same way after a change write-contract matrix tools/qc/write-contract-matrix.js (header comment is the manual)
    which cells changed between two trees and why compat classification tools/qc/compat/ (README gives the lane)
    does a specific defect reproduce, and does the fix remove it a lab tools/lab/<topic>/ (each has a README with its command and its controls)
    does a client still read and write correctly against a tree consumer survey, replay lab reports/consumer-impact-<version>/, tools/lab/rc-soak
    does a gate measure what it claims vacuity controls make queue-vacuity, queue/gate-controls.yaml
    what does the matrix of MongoDB versions say tools/lab/mongo-server-matrix floor and ceiling only (Node and MongoDB edges)

    Run the matrix¶

    # a fresh MongoDB on its own port; never a real site
docker run -d --name wc-mongo-$$ -p 27151:27017 mongo:7.0
WC_WORKTREE=externals/work/<crm worktree> WC_MONGO=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27151 \
  node tools/qc/write-contract-matrix.js --out /tmp/<scratch>/after.json
node tools/qc/write-contract-matrix.js --compare tools/qc/results/write-contract-matrix/<pin>.json /tmp/<scratch>/after.json

    For a new differential matrix capture, run each compared tree twice; a cell that differs between a tree's own runs is noise, not a finding. This repeatability check belongs to the comparative experiment, not every helper validation or full-suite campaign; justified reuse of an accepted capture retains its source scope. Predict the differing cells before the run and write the prediction down; a result that matches a prediction is evidence, a result that surprises is a finding to stop and report. Pins live in tools/qc/results/write-contract-matrix/; the settings and database version of every run are part of the record.

    Build or extend a lab¶

    1. Copy the shape of a neighbouring tools/lab/<topic>/: a README that states the question, the command, the expected output and the control; a runner that boots from WC_WORKTREE or an explicit worktree path; results under results/ with the tree SHA in the file name.
    2. Seed synthetic data only. Database names contain test. Drop the database at the end.
    3. Controls are authored, never derived. For each claimed property, define and run a meaningful failing state. A control family may cover several assertions sharing a failure mechanism. Restore each break; run the unmodified focused capability suite after the control family. Record positive, semantic failure and restoration results. A revert that does not reproduce the original symptom proves nothing about the check.
    4. Stop and report when the code does not match the brief. Do not substitute the nearest thing that works; most real defects in this programme surfaced exactly at that point.

    Record the run¶

    • A dated file under docs/60-research/<horizon>/<topic>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md or the next R<n> entry of the integration record: tree SHAs, Node and MongoDB versions, settings, command, totals, the controls and what they showed, and what the run does not cover.
    • Label every figure reproduced (you ran it) or read-derived (you inferred it from source).
    • Link the record from the queue item's evidence: list and from the release record row.
    • A defect found this way gets a register entry by mechanism; if it is live on the shipping release, no request or payload that would work against a deployed site goes in the public tree.

    Traps that cost a run¶

    • Headless client tests load node_modules/.cache's bundle: rebuild per worktree with npm run postinstall; never borrow another checkout's node_modules.
    • The matrix's identifier-format cells seed shared identifiers straight to MongoDB and crash with the unique index on; compare index-on and index-off runs with the same flags.
    • A test tier can miss shared-database interference. Run the full npm test before "ready".
    • The local mongod on 27017 is an old version; use a container and read db.version() before labelling a run.
    • ENOSPC from a watcher is usually the inotify limit, not disk.
